click_method: AppleScript inside System Events: 'click menu bar item 1 of menu bar 2 of process Anticipy'

measurement_1.description: Single-process AppleScript with internal gdate timing (eliminates per-call osascript boot)

measurement_2.description: Bash shell with per-poll osascript calls (high overhead, upper bound)
measurement_2.note: Each osascript boot is ~150 ms; measurement is dominated by tooling overhead, not Tauri.
